	try:

		selected = 'all'
	val_cols = ['IWT Actual','POGT Actual','DAT Actual','IWT Target','POGT Target','DAT Target']
	eq_data  = {}
	eq_names = {}
	for r in range(value.getRowCount()):
		ts    = value.getValueAt(r, 't_stamp')
		eq_id = str(value.getValueAt(r, 'coolingTowerDataID') or '')
		eq_nm = str(value.getValueAt(r, 'equipmentName') or eq_id)
		pl    = str(value.getValueAt(r, 'paramLabel') or '')
		v     = value.getValueAt(r, 'value')
		if selected != 'all' and eq_id != str(selected): continue
		if pl not in val_cols: continue
		ts_ms = system.date.toMillis(ts) if ts else None
		if ts_ms is None: continue
		eq_names[eq_id] = eq_nm
		if eq_id not in eq_data: eq_data[eq_id] = {}
		if ts_ms not in eq_data[eq_id]: eq_data[eq_id][ts_ms] = {'time': ts_ms}
		if v is not None: eq_data[eq_id][ts_ms][pl] = v
	result = []
	for eq_id in sorted(eq_data.keys()):
		pts = [eq_data[eq_id][ts] for ts in sorted(eq_data[eq_id].keys())]
		result.append({'name': eq_names.get(eq_id, eq_id), 'data': pts})
	return result

raw = self.view.custom.rawHistoryData
	selected = currentValue.value
	if raw is None: self.view.custom.chartData = []; return
	val_cols = ['IWT Actual','POGT Actual','DAT Actual','IWT Target','POGT Target','DAT Target']
	eq_data  = {}
	eq_names = {}
	for r in range(raw.getRowCount()):
		ts    = raw.getValueAt(r, 't_stamp')
		eq_id = str(raw.getValueAt(r, 'coolingTowerDataID') or '')
		eq_nm = str(raw.getValueAt(r, 'equipmentName') or eq_id)
		pl    = str(raw.getValueAt(r, 'paramLabel') or '')
		v     = raw.getValueAt(r, 'value')
		if selected != 'all' and eq_id != str(selected): continue
		if pl not in val_cols: continue
		ts_ms = system.date.toMillis(ts) if ts else None
		if ts_ms is None: continue
		eq_names[eq_id] = eq_nm
		if eq_id not in eq_data: eq_data[eq_id] = {}
		if ts_ms not in eq_data[eq_id]: eq_data[eq_id][ts_ms] = {'time': ts_ms}
		if v is not None: eq_data[eq_id][ts_ms][pl] = v
	result = []
	for eq_id in sorted(eq_data.keys()):
		pts = [eq_data[eq_id][ts] for ts in sorted(eq_data[eq_id].keys())]
		result.append({'name': eq_names.get(eq_id, eq_id), 'data': pts})
	self.view.custom.chartData = result
